visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a white T-shirt and grey patterned pants stands on a teal-colored indoor badminton court under bright, industrial-style lighting with a pink-beamed ceiling. He is adjusting a smartphone mounted on a vertical metal stand. In the background, two players are actively engaged in a game. (2) Close-up view of the man's face and hands as he holds a compact, black dual-lens 360 camera. He then moves towards the badminton net and attaches the camera securely to the top edge of the net post. (3) The perspective shifts to a wide-angle, 360-degree distorted view from the center of the court. Players in black and white athletic wear move rapidly across the frame, executing smashes and defensive dives. (4) Multiple quick-cut sequences showing high-action badminton play from the 360-degree perspective. Two players are seen high-fiving in the center of the court after a successful play. (5) The scene transitions to a medium close-up of the man now wearing a black hoodie, speaking directly to the camera while seated inside a vehicle. A digital interface overlay appears on the right side showing the 'DJI Studio' mobile editing application, with a mouse cursor moving to select keyframes and zoom levels.

The acoustic environment includes a faint indoor room tone and the high-frequency rhythmic 'pop' of shuttlecock impacts. (2) The narrator's speech continues as a metallic, mechanical 'click' sound effect triggers to emphasize the attachment of a camera to a stand. (3) Sound effects profile shifts to include high-energy cheering and vocalizations like 'Sui!' and 'Ooh!' from multiple people, layered with sharp, percussive impact sounds of badminton rackets hitting shuttlecocks. The BGM remains energetic and rhythmic. (4) Rapid-fire impact SFX correspond with visual smashes, followed by the sound of laughter and distant clapping. The BGM maintains a consistent tempo. (5) The audio transitions to a clearer narration style with reduced background noise. Digital UI 'blips' and soft 'pop' sound effects are synchronized with the visual demonstration of video editing software. The BGM continues at a slightly lower volume level.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the DJI Osmo 360 camera as a superior tool for filming fast-paced sports like badminton, while providing a brief tutorial on how to use the DJI Studio app to edit 360-degree footage effectively.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the DJI Osmo 360, shows the product being used, features a tutorial for the official DJI Studio app, and uses on-screen branding.
